identityDescription: Nery Mizuki is Yuri Cunha’s personal mascot, created for his projects, products and websites, including Mnerys. Curious and warm, she brings a familiar face to the things he builds.
appearance: Copper-red hair. Amber eyes. Cream hair bows. A dark charcoal hoodie with warm terracotta and orange accents.
style: Friendly 2D anime / chibi illustration, dark charcoal backgrounds and warm highlights.
ruleHair: Never change her hair or eye color.
rulePurple: Never use purple brand accents on her.
ruleLogo: Never replace the geometric M logo with a mascot icon in a favicon, PWA, app icon or wordmark.
ruleRedraw: Never redraw or restyle her outside the approved character sheet without the rights holder’s approval.
ruleLicense: Never claim the artwork is open-source, AGPL-3.0 or freely reusable.
